p139: The group left the fortress and were out at the outskirts of Vaucouleurs, walking through the forests. No one didn’t say a word to each other, all of their eyes focused on the woman leading them away.
p140: While the others looked suspicious at the woman, Sora however wasn’t. In fact, he was seriously thankful to this cloaked woman who saved that older woman’s life. Even though he couldn’t get a good look at her face, he could tell that she was probably around the same age as him, Ritsuka and Mash. Earlier, after that woman spoke to her, he saw the cloaked woman looked really sad for some reason. It made him wonder if she knew who she was because obviously the older woman also knew who she was as well.

a_n_end1: Author’s Note: Oh man! Thank you guys so much for the positive responses on the first chapter! Soon as I saw the first 20 reviews that appeared, I immediately got to work on this chapter. Now here we are at the second chapter and at the start of the first Singularity.
a_n_end2: Originally, this chapter was meant to have Sora settling in and getting to know everyone at Chaldea, but I decided to hold it off when I’m doing the Interlude chapters after each Singularities arc is finished. To let you guys know, I’ll also be doing some Event Singularity as well. So yeah, Sora will definitely be telling a lot of stories of the worlds he visited. He will discover that most of those worlds are based on fictional stories in the Fate world, just like with Atlantica and Wonderland, while everyone in Chaldea will discover that those fictional stories are real in Sora’s reality. So to the people of Chaldea, they would think that Sora’s world is some sort of fictional world where fictional stories are real, which is the overall theme of Kingdom Hearts IV.
